title: Codes, Patterns and Shapes of Contemporary Online Antisemitism and Conspiracy Narratives - an Annotation Guide and Labeled German-Language Dataset in the Context of COVID-19

bias_targets.methodology: Manual annotation of a German-language Telegram dataset using a custom annotation scheme based on the IHRA definition, extended to identify explicit, post-Holocaust, and encoded forms of antisemitism, alongside statistical analysis (chi-square tests) of correlated words.
